places.note: Dense street blocks east of the railway identify the market-town area, not its legal limits. / 铁路以东的密集街区指示深圳墟的大致范围，并非行政界线。
Approximate search area west of the old commercial crossroads. No individual roof is identified as the theatre. / 旧商业十字街以西的大致查找范围，未确认戏院屋顶。
Caiwuwei county-seat area on the west approach. Neither a specific office nor the compound boundary is identified. / 西侧进路旁的蔡屋围县治片区，未确认具体机关建筑和院界。
The platforms and multiple tracks north of the bridge identify the station area. The station building footprint is unresolved. / 桥北站台及多股铁轨指示站场，站房轮廓尚未确认。
A broad search area north of the market based on the plate’s 汽车站 label. No specific compound has been matched. / 据图志「汽车站」标注推定的墟北查找区，未确认具体院落。
Likely location on land beside the pond group near the confluence; not a roof-by-roof assignment. / 近汇流处塘群旁的陆地候选位置，未逐栋定位。
Candidate built-up area east of the elongated pond strip. The old village boundary is unknown. / 狭长塘群以东建成区的候选位置，旧村范围未明。
Search area for the east–west market street. Do not equate it with the bright wider corridor south of the market. / 旧墟东西向街道的查找区，不等同于墟南较宽的亮色通道。
Approximate north–south approach to the old crossroads; the junction and line are not confirmed. / 旧十字街南北进路的示意位置，未确认准确路口和线位。
Candidate west-side works corridor. The whole bright cut cannot be assigned to one named section or construction date. / 西侧施工走廊候选位置，整条亮色地带不能统一定名或定年。
The main railway crosses the river here. This marks the crossing, not the extent of every passenger facility. / 铁路主线在此过河，标注过河点而非各客运设施的范围。
The western short bridge is one candidate. Nearby crossings prevent a firm identification of the freight crossing from this image alone. / 西侧短桥是一个候选点；附近另有过河设施，仅凭影像不能确认货运口岸位置。
Label on the main river’s western meander; lines record visible reaches, not surveyed banks or a tide datum. / 标注主河西段弯道；线条表示可辨河段，不是实测岸线或水位基准。
Mark on the channel leading to the Yumin confluence. Upstream continuity and dates of channel works are unresolved. / 标注通往渔民村汇流处的河段；上游衔接及整治年代待核。
Separately visible water cells at the confluence. The pond group is not a village footprint or a complete fishpond inventory. / 汇流处可分别辨认的塘格，并非村界或鱼塘总清单。
The pre-SEZ plate places the hill east of the station near the river. This marker is not a confirmed 1980 summit, contour or grading date. / 特区前图志将罗湖山标在车站东侧近河处；此点不是已确认的 1980 年山顶、等高线或平整日期。
Broad upland near the mapped locality. Neither crest height nor slope limits are derived here. / 地图地名附近的高地区域，未测定山顶高程或坡地范围。
The lower trace ends at the approach beside the main rail. No upstream junction or realignment is assigned.
A bridge and river are visible; which period crossing facility it served is not established.
Historic contour, grade and date of earthworks not established; modern relief is a proxy.
Do not identify the cleared patches with a named factory, Electronics Building or the exact completed section of Shennan.
